text: Setting clear project goals is essential for success. One useful method is using SMART goals, which means goals that are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. When you plan a project, you should also define important milestones—key points that show your progress. Deliverables are the actual results or products you promise to complete. Before you start, make sure all stakeholders agree on the goals. Stakeholder alignment helps everyone understand what success looks like and reduces confusion later. By combining SMART goals, milestones, deliverables, and stakeholder alignment, your project is more likely to stay on track and meet expectations.
